name: Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E

valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: no market capitalisation is on file for this security, so a market-based multiple cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 10.87 percent a year from FY2021 (1.993e+07) to FY2025 (3.011e+07), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: the filed earnings-per-share row for FY2025
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2024
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2025
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 5273%: market cap 4500000000 used (price x shares) vs 83749325 on file
